record.title: Notice on deepening the market-oriented reform of feed-in tariffs for new energy and promoting the high-quality development of new energy
record.issuer: National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC); National Energy Administration (NEA)
record.relation_note: Hard rules directly related to grid connection: mandatory storage allocation must not be made a precondition for the approval, grid connection or feed-in of new renewable projects; renewable generation output in principle enters the power market in full
record.note: NDRC original text; the document sets no separate unified effective date, so effective_date is left blank.
